info.title: Sync API
info.description: Sync the desktop app with one or more servers, and manage other Termix servers as remote sites from a master.

bearerAuth.description: Session token sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the token.

cookieAuth.name: jwt
cookieAuth.description: Session JWT cookie set at sign-in. When present, it takes precedence over the Authorization header.

apiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the key, which starts with tmx_. It acts as the key owner and cannot act as anyone else.

get.description: Counts of sites, how many answer, and how many of their hosts are online, from the last refresh.
The Termix servers this server manages, with how the last refresh went. API keys are never returned.

post.summary: Add a remote site
post.description: Saves the site with an API key made on it, then mirrors its SSH hosts as read only hosts owned by the user who adds it, in a folder named after the site. The key's user on the remote decides which hosts exist here. shareRoles lists the roles the hosts are shared with.

200.description: The site, with the result of the first refresh.

put.summary: Rename a site, replace its API key or change who sees its hosts
put.description: A new API key is tried straight away. A new name moves the hosts to a folder with that name.

delete.description: Forgets the site and its cached hosts. The API key stays valid on the remote until it is deleted there.

post.summary: Read a site's hosts and status again
post.description: Hosts and status are also refreshed every minute.

get.summary: Roles the mirrored hosts can be shared with
get.description: For the picker when adding or editing a site.

get.summary: Is this a Termix server that can sync
get.description: Public. Used by a client before it signs in. The client may send clientType and deviceId as query values, which are not stored.

200.description: Server name, version and sync protocol version.

post.summary: Link a client to this account
post.description: Trades the short login session the client just signed in with for a long lived device session, which shows in the account's sessions list and is revoked like any other. The login session is ended. clientType and deviceId are optional and default to desktop and none.

200.description: The device session token and the account it belongs to.

403.description: API keys cannot link a client.

post.summary: Keep a linked client's session from expiring
post.description: Returns a fresh device session when the current one ends within 60 days, and ends the old one five minutes later. Asking again with the old token in that time returns the same new token. Otherwise returns null and the client keeps its token.

post.summary: End a linked client's session
post.description: Called by a client when it unlinks, so its session stops working here right away.

get.summary: The clients linked to this account
get.description: Each client that linked with a deviceId, with its type, name and when it last linked. Clients that sent no deviceId are not listed.

get.summary: Pull what changed for this account after a cursor
get.description: Returns records in change order. Each has the entity type, syncId, revision, whether it is deleted, and the row when it is not. Records of entity types this server does not currently run are skipped but still move the cursor.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated entity types, to backfill only those.

200.description: A page of changes, the next cursor and whether more remain.

400.description: The cursor or limit is not a non-negative integer.

post.summary: Push a client's changes
post.description: Each op carries the revision the client last saw. Ops are applied in dependency order and each gets its own result, ok with the new revision, conflict with the server's version, or rejected with a reason.

200.description: One result per op, in the order sent.

get.summary: Stream a notice whenever this account's data changes
get.description: Server-sent events. A "change" event means there is something new to pull. Comments are sent every 25 seconds to keep proxies from closing the stream.

get.summary: This server's id for a host, by its sync id
get.description: For a linked desktop that asks the server to act on a host (a tunnel through it), which needs the server's own id. Only for hosts the caller can connect to.

404.description: No such host the caller can connect to.

post.summary: This server's ids for many rows, by sync id
post.description: The batch form of /sync/v2/hosts/{syncId}. Send lists of sync ids by type (hosts, snippets and so on). Hosts are the ones the caller can connect to, other types only the caller's own rows. Unknown ids are left out. Up to 1000 ids in all.

200.description: Ids by type, then by sync id.

400.description: The body is not lists of sync ids, or has too many.

get.summary: Status of the hosts this account can see, keyed by sync id
get.description: For a linked desktop whose hosts connect through this server, so it can show their status against its own copies.

200.description: Status entries by host sync id.

get.summary: The features this server runs, for a linked desktop to mirror
get.description: Every installed plugin with its version, where it came from, whether it is on, how a desktop should treat it and which sync entities it owns. registryKeys lists the signing keys of the custom registries an admin added, so plugins from them load on the desktop.

get.summary: Download an installed plugin so a linked desktop can install it
get.description: Only for plugins installed on this server, or bundled ones replaced by a signed update. Sends the original .tmxplug when there is one, with its signature in the X-Termix-Signature header, otherwise a fresh archive of the plugin folder.

404.description: No installed plugin with that id.

get.summary: This desktop's link to a server
get.description: Desktop only. Whether the app is linked, to which server and account, how syncing is going, and which kinds of data sync.

post.summary: Check a server address before linking
post.description: Desktop only. Tries the server with the given proxy settings and says what is in the way, if anything. On success the proxy settings are also applied to the desktop's browser session so the sign-in page loads.

200.description: The server's name and version, or the problem found.

get.summary: How much this desktop has that would sync
get.description: Desktop only. Row counts per kind of data, shown before choosing whether to merge this desktop's data into the account or replace it.

post.summary: Link this desktop to a server account
post.description: Desktop only. Takes the session from signing in to the server, trades it for a long-lived desktop session, and starts syncing. "merge" uploads this desktop's data into the account; "replace" deletes it here first and takes the account's.

post.summary: Sign this desktop back in after its session ended
post.description: Desktop only. Takes a new sign-in session for the same account and resumes syncing where it stopped.

200.description: Signed in again; the new status.

409.description: The sign-in was for a different account.

post.summary: Unlink this desktop from its server
post.description: Desktop only. Ends the desktop's session on the server when it can be reached. With keepData the synced data stays on this device as its own; otherwise it is deleted. Copies of what others shared with the account are always removed.

post.summary: Sync now
post.description: Desktop only. Runs a sync pass and waits for it.

put.summary: Change what syncs and how the server is reached
put.description: Desktop only. disabledTypes lists the kinds of data that stay on this device. Proxy headers, basic auth and the client certificate left blank keep their saved values.

get.summary: Local edits that lost to a newer edit on the server
get.description: Desktop only. The server's version was kept; each entry holds this device's version so it can be restored.

post.summary: Settle every conflict
post.description: Desktop only. keep "mine" puts this device's version of each one back, and the next sync sends them to the server. keep "server" drops them all.

200.description: Settled. Holds how many were settled and how many failed.

400.description: keep is not mine or server.

post.summary: Settle a conflict
post.description: Desktop only. keep "mine" puts this device's version back, and the next sync sends it to the server. keep "server" drops it.

get.description: Desktop only. Each entry names the record and why the server refused it. A refused change is not sent again until it changes or is retried.

post.summary: Send refused changes again
post.description: Desktop only. Clears every refusal and syncs.

get.summary: The linked server and session, for connecting to it directly
get.description: Desktop only. Used when a host is set to connect through the server rather than from this device.

200.description: The server address and session token, or nulls when not linked.

get.description: Desktop only. Each account is a local user that holds the copy of one linked server, or this device's own data. Exactly one is active.

200.description: The accounts and which one is active.

post.summary: Add an empty account for another server
post.description: Desktop only. Makes a new local account and does not switch to it. Switch to it, then link it to a server like any other.

post.summary: Switch the active account
post.description: Desktop only. Returns a session for that account and sets it as the cookie, so the app should store the token and reload after this. Data of the accounts never mixes.

delete.description: Desktop only. Ends its link to the server when it can be reached, then deletes the account and its copy of the data. The active account cannot be removed.

400.description: This account is active, or the last one.

get.summary: The accounts signed in on this browser
get.description: Server only. The other accounts of this server that were signed in here and still have a working session. Accounts on other servers cannot be held by a browser, since the session cookie belongs to one address.

200.description: The accounts, whether this browser has a ring, and which one is current.

post.summary: Keep this account and go sign in with another
post.description: Server only. Remembers the current session for this browser and removes the sign in cookie, so the sign in page shows. The session itself is not ended.

post.summary: Add the account that just signed in to this browser's accounts
post.description: Server only. Does nothing when this browser has no accounts ring.

200.description: Added, or nothing to add to.

post.summary: Switch this browser to another signed in account
post.description: Server only. Sets the sign in cookie to that account's session. The app should reload after this.

404.description: That account is not signed in here any more.

delete.summary: Sign an account out of this browser
delete.description: Server only. Ends that account's session and forgets it here. Signing out the current account also removes the sign in cookie.
